title: Good Quality Whey Protein
body:
Hey all,
Been waiting for 2 cycles now at Chemist Warehouse for the Musashi to go on 40%/50% off but the latest catalogue still hasn't marked it down well..
Only option I found is the current 100% Whey Musashi 900g ones at Woolies but they only have chocolate, I prefer Vanilla since I blend it with frozen fruits.
My current 2kg musashi stock is running low so need to stock up soon, doubt I could wait another 2 weeks for the next Chemist Warehouse cycle to see if it gets marked down.
Won't be too fussed about flavours if its a good price. Thanks in advance!
